description: Per-workspace VisionStore + SettingsStore + DesignSessionManager registries. Vision/lifecycle/gate/settings routes use `req.workspace`. Depends on 197. Delivered 2026-09-05 by the wiring repair (compose 67c791b3, CHANGELOG "Workspace isolation") as a per-workspace runtime: one router and service set per binding (`server/workspace-runtime.js:110-120`), not per-route `req.workspace`. Verified 2026-11-02: `test/workspace-switch-runtime.test.js` + `test/workspace-review-fixes.test.js` 18/18. SettingsStore and DesignSessionManager are per VisionServer, so per workspace (`server/vision-server.js:102`, `:186-192`).
